notes: Read the relevant Chapter 3 pages from this actual supplied PDF using page-scoped text extraction; visually inspected PDF page 84 (printed 75). This is a selected-page review, not a whole-book claim.
Reviewed statement/truth value, negation, inclusive OR, implication and both-direction biconditional, converse/inverse/contrapositive, counterexamples and deductive/inductive argument sections.
Example 3(b), PDF page 67, treats some as excluding all; that interpretation is not followed. The bank explicitly uses at least one, possibly all.

PDF page 84 contains a contradictory sentence defining validity through actual truth before correctly distinguishing form and soundness later on the same page; PDF page 85 Example 17(f) says invalid but sound. These inconsistencies are not copied into hints. Use validity as truth preservation by form, and soundness as validity with true premises, consistent with the bank and DSKP false-premise example.
The inductive hints use likelihood and scope of observations; a finite pattern or sample does not become a deductive guarantee.
Read the corresponding selected Chapter 3 pages from this actual supplied BM PDF; visually inspected PDF page 76 (printed 75).

Checked pernyataan, nilai kebenaran, penafian, implikasi, antejadian, akibat, akas, songsangan, kontrapositif, contoh penyangkal, premis, kesimpulan, sah, munasabah, deduktif, induktif and pengitlakan.

PDF page 76 correctly separates valid form from false premises. PDF page 77 Example 17(f) labels an invalid argument munasabah; do not copy that inconsistent example into the bank’s explicit soundness definition.
Some/sebilangan retains the explicit at-least-one meaning in the bank, including the possibility of all; it is never paraphrased as exactly some but not all.
Read actual supplied DSKP PDF pages 56–59, printed pages 42–45, covering 3.1.1–3.1.6 and 3.2.1–3.2.6; visually inspected PDF page 58 (printed 44).

Verified the converse, inverse and contrapositive forms and the three valid deductive forms. The valid-but-unsound example with a false universal premise supports preserving the form/truth distinction.
Inductive strength concerns how likely the conclusion is assuming true premises; observing several cases or selecting a broad sample is not a universal deductive proof.
No claim is made that these MCQs assess the whole DSKP or establish official TP mastery.

hintSteps.text: Kesimpulan yang sah mesti benar dalam setiap kes yang dibenarkan oleh premis.
Semak perkara yang dinyatakan oleh peraturan tentang token Api dan kemungkinan yang masih terbuka bagi token tanpa Api.

malay.hint: Kesimpulan yang sah mesti benar dalam setiap kes yang dibenarkan oleh premis. Semak perkara yang dinyatakan oleh peraturan tentang token Api dan kemungkinan yang masih terbuka bagi token tanpa Api.
malay.moreHint: Bina dua kes percubaan bagi R tanpa tanda Api: bercahaya dan tidak bercahaya. Bagi setiap kes, semak sama ada kedua-dua premis boleh benar dan sama ada kesimpulan yang dicadangkan turut benar.

items.rationale: This tests denying the antecedent without teaching the incorrect claim that an inverse is always equivalent to its original.

findings: The prompt’s validity and soundness definitions are accurate; preserve them.
The supplied textbooks have inconsistent wording around validity/soundness, so retain the formal guarantee and DSKP false-premise distinction rather than copying those inconsistencies.

hintSteps.text: Check the argument’s form separately from the actual truth of its premises.
For soundness, check that the form is valid and that every premise is true.

english.hint: Check the argument’s form separately from the actual truth of its premises. For soundness, check that the form is valid and that every premise is true.
english.moreHint: Replace odd with P and divisible by 4 with Q to inspect the form. Separately test whether 3 has each property, and use that check when judging the first premise.

hintSteps.text: Semak bentuk hujah secara berasingan daripada kebenaran sebenar premisnya.
Untuk menentukan kemunasabahan, semak bahawa bentuk hujah sah dan setiap premis benar.

malay.hint: Semak bentuk hujah secara berasingan daripada kebenaran sebenar premisnya. Untuk menentukan kemunasabahan, semak bahawa bentuk hujah sah dan setiap premis benar.
malay.moreHint: Gantikan ganjil dengan P dan boleh dibahagi tepat dengan 4 dengan Q untuk meneliti bentuk hujah. Secara berasingan, uji sama ada 3 mempunyai setiap sifat, lalu gunakan semakan itu untuk menilai premis pertama.

items.rationale: The support preserves the distinction between a valid form and true premises, without announcing either assessment for this argument.

findings: The direct-proof restriction avoids ambiguity about unrelated additional facts.
Give a specific subject/property check for every option instead of completing the missing premise for the learner.

hintSteps.text: An all-A-are-B rule applies to a particular object only when that object is known to be A.
The missing premise must connect the named card to the rule’s condition.

english.hint: An all-A-are-B rule applies to a particular object only when that object is known to be A. The missing premise must connect the named card to the rule’s condition.
english.moreHint: Mark c7 in each option. For an option that mentions it, check whether the stated property is the rule’s condition or its result, and whether the property is affirmed or negated.

hintSteps.text: Peraturan semua-A-ialah-B terpakai kepada objek tertentu hanya apabila objek itu diketahui sebagai A.
Premis yang hilang mesti menghubungkan kad yang dinamakan dengan syarat peraturan.

malay.hint: Peraturan semua-A-ialah-B terpakai kepada objek tertentu hanya apabila objek itu diketahui sebagai A. Premis yang hilang mesti menghubungkan kad yang dinamakan dengan syarat peraturan.
malay.moreHint: Tandakan c7 dalam setiap pilihan. Bagi pilihan yang menyebutnya, semak sama ada sifat yang dinyatakan ialah syarat atau hasil peraturan, serta sama ada sifat itu ditegaskan atau dinafikan.

items.rationale: The scaffold requires the learner to select the fact that lets the given rule apply directly to c7.

findings: The prompt explicitly says no rule for all terms is given; this prevents a false deductive guarantee.
More Hint uses the observed differences but does not label the reasoning type or claim a unique continuation.

hintSteps.text: Classify how the prediction is supported, rather than only checking whether 10 fits the visible pattern.
Distinguish applying a supplied generating rule from extending examples to an unobserved term.

english.hint: Classify how the prediction is supported, rather than only checking whether 10 fits the visible pattern. Distinguish applying a supplied generating rule from extending examples to an unobserved term.
english.moreHint: Compute 4 − 2, 6 − 4 and 8 − 6. Ask which feature is assumed to continue in the prediction, and check whether that assumption was supplied as a rule.

hintSteps.text: Kelaskan asas sokongan bagi ramalan itu, bukan sekadar menyemak sama ada 10 sepadan dengan pola yang kelihatan.
Bezakan penggunaan peraturan penjanaan yang diberi daripada pelanjutan contoh kepada sebutan yang belum diperhatikan.

malay.hint: Kelaskan asas sokongan bagi ramalan itu, bukan sekadar menyemak sama ada 10 sepadan dengan pola yang kelihatan. Bezakan penggunaan peraturan penjanaan yang diberi daripada pelanjutan contoh kepada sebutan yang belum diperhatikan.
malay.moreHint: Hitung 4 − 2, 6 − 4 dan 8 − 6. Tentukan ciri yang diandaikan berterusan dalam ramalan, dan semak sama ada andaian itu diberikan sebagai peraturan.

items.rationale: The learner identifies the evidential move from observations to conjecture while the given numbers and prediction stay unchanged.

findings: The prompt correctly limits the evidence to three observed rooms.
Compare both possibilities for unvisited rooms so that unproved is not confused with certainly false.

hintSteps.text: Compare the cases actually observed with the scope of the conclusion.
Supporting examples need not settle what happens in rooms that were not checked.

english.hint: Compare the cases actually observed with the scope of the conclusion. Supporting examples need not settle what happens in rooms that were not checked.
english.moreHint: Consider two possible unvisited rooms: one with a chest and one without. Check whether the three recorded observations settle which case occurs, then compare the claim’s scope with the evidence’s scope.

hintSteps.text: Bandingkan kes yang benar-benar diperhatikan dengan skop kesimpulan.
Contoh yang menyokong tidak semestinya menentukan keadaan dalam bilik yang belum diperiksa.

malay.hint: Bandingkan kes yang benar-benar diperhatikan dengan skop kesimpulan. Contoh yang menyokong tidak semestinya menentukan keadaan dalam bilik yang belum diperiksa.
malay.moreHint: Pertimbangkan dua kemungkinan bagi bilik yang belum dikunjungi: satu mempunyai peti dan satu lagi tidak. Semak sama ada tiga pemerhatian yang direkodkan menentukan kes yang berlaku, kemudian bandingkan skop pernyataan dengan skop bukti.

items.rationale: The support teaches the gap between observations and a universal conclusion without quoting the final assessment.

findings: The prompt appropriately asks for the strongest basis among these options, not proof of every room.
Keep evidence quality broader than sample size alone; avoid quoting the large-random-sample option in More Hint.

hintSteps.text: Judge how well each method covers the rooms named by the claim.
Compare distinct rooms, coverage of both stages and room types, and selection that might favour supporting cases.

english.hint: Judge how well each method covers the rooms named by the claim. Compare distinct rooms, coverage of both stages and room types, and selection that might favour supporting cases.
english.moreHint: For each option, note the number of distinct rooms, the stages and types covered, and how rooms are selected. Revisiting one room adds visits; check whether it adds new cases.

hintSteps.text: Nilai sejauh mana setiap kaedah meliputi bilik yang dimaksudkan oleh pernyataan.
Bandingkan bilik berbeza, liputan kedua-dua peringkat dan jenis bilik, serta pemilihan yang mungkin memihak kepada kes penyokong.

malay.hint: Nilai sejauh mana setiap kaedah meliputi bilik yang dimaksudkan oleh pernyataan. Bandingkan bilik berbeza, liputan kedua-dua peringkat dan jenis bilik, serta pemilihan yang mungkin memihak kepada kes penyokong.
malay.moreHint: Bagi setiap pilihan, catat bilangan bilik berbeza, peringkat dan jenis yang diliputi, serta cara bilik dipilih. Mengunjungi semula satu bilik menambah lawatan; semak sama ada hal itu menambah kes baharu.

items.rationale: The selection criteria support a comparison of coverage and bias without treating inductive evidence as deductive proof.

findings: Both arguments are sufficiently explicit; no prompt change is needed.
Define the classification criteria and locate the evidence without stating the final A/B label pair.

hintSteps.text: Deductive reasoning applies a supplied rule, while inductive reasoning extends observed cases.
Identify the source of support for each argument separately before pairing the labels.

english.hint: Deductive reasoning applies a supplied rule, while inductive reasoning extends observed cases. Identify the source of support for each argument separately before pairing the labels.
english.moreHint: In A, mark the general rule and the fact about 12. In B, mark the result that has not been tested. For each argument, ask whether the conclusion follows by applying a given rule or predicts beyond checked cases.

hintSteps.text: Penaakulan deduktif menggunakan peraturan yang diberi, manakala penaakulan induktif melanjutkan kes yang diperhatikan.
Kenal pasti asas sokongan bagi setiap hujah secara berasingan sebelum memadankan labelnya.

malay.hint: Penaakulan deduktif menggunakan peraturan yang diberi, manakala penaakulan induktif melanjutkan kes yang diperhatikan. Kenal pasti asas sokongan bagi setiap hujah secara berasingan sebelum memadankan labelnya.
malay.moreHint: Dalam A, tandakan peraturan umum dan fakta tentang 12. Dalam B, tandakan hasil yang belum diuji. Bagi setiap hujah, tentukan sama ada kesimpulan terhasil melalui penggunaan peraturan yang diberi atau meramalkan sesuatu yang melampaui kes yang diperiksa.

items.rationale: The learner distinguishes rule application from extrapolation and must still assign and order the two labels.

findings: The direct-application wording is clear; preserve all category and mark definitions.
More Hint checks direction and universal applicability, distinguishing a general added premise from some Attack cards.

hintSteps.text: Start from the property already known about c7 and identify the property needed for the conclusion.
The added premise must provide a rule that applies to that specific card in the needed direction.

english.hint: Start from the property already known about c7 and identify the property needed for the conclusion. The added premise must provide a rule that applies to that specific card in the needed direction.
english.moreHint: Starting from c7 is Attack, check each option: can it apply to every card in that known category, including c7, and reach the required mark? An existence claim may refer to a different card.

hintSteps.text: Mulakan dengan sifat c7 yang sudah diketahui dan kenal pasti sifat yang diperlukan oleh kesimpulan.
Premis tambahan mesti memberikan peraturan yang terpakai kepada kad tertentu itu mengikut arah yang diperlukan.

malay.hint: Mulakan dengan sifat c7 yang sudah diketahui dan kenal pasti sifat yang diperlukan oleh kesimpulan. Premis tambahan mesti memberikan peraturan yang terpakai kepada kad tertentu itu mengikut arah yang diperlukan.
malay.moreHint: Bermula dengan c7 ialah Serangan, semak setiap pilihan: bolehkah pilihan itu terpakai kepada setiap kad dalam kategori yang diketahui itu, termasuk c7, dan menghasilkan tanda yang diperlukan? Pernyataan kewujudan mungkin merujuk kad lain.

items.rationale: The scaffold does not assume the original rule can be reversed and does not state the full added rule that is the answer.

findings: The same-key/lamp/trap test restriction is important and already explicit.
The two-stage backward check is appropriate; leave the intermediate lamp judgement and final key conclusion unstated.

hintSteps.text: Work backwards from the stated final fact, keeping all three premises about the same test.
At each rule, test whether its condition can hold without contradicting the result known to be absent.

english.hint: Work backwards from the stated final fact, keeping all three premises about the same test. At each rule, test whether its condition can hold without contradicting the result known to be absent.
english.moreHint: Begin with premise 2: temporarily suppose the lamp glows and compare its required trap result with premise 3. Then use what you establish about the lamp to check premise 1.

hintSteps.text: Bekerja secara mengundur daripada fakta akhir yang dinyatakan sambil memastikan ketiga-tiga premis merujuk ujian yang sama.
Pada setiap peraturan, uji sama ada antejadiannya boleh benar tanpa bercanggah dengan akibat yang diketahui tidak berlaku.

malay.hint: Bekerja secara mengundur daripada fakta akhir yang dinyatakan sambil memastikan ketiga-tiga premis merujuk ujian yang sama. Pada setiap peraturan, uji sama ada antejadiannya boleh benar tanpa bercanggah dengan akibat yang diketahui tidak berlaku.
malay.moreHint: Mulakan dengan premis 2: andaikan sementara lampu bercahaya dan bandingkan hasil perangkap yang diwajibkannya dengan premis 3. Kemudian gunakan perkara yang anda tentukan tentang lampu untuk menyemak premis 1.

items.rationale: The learner applies the absent-result deduction twice without being given either derived conclusion or generalising beyond the specified test.
